description: Zobolin stage E step 23: the slice_vista views with the compass strip drawn at the top of the view (game/ui/quest_compass.gd), with fixed markers at the slice's named places (the measuring runs have no quests; --with-compass, SliceMarkers). Its stopwatch is quest_markers (one pass per frame: the markers' directions and the Dear ImGui strip). With -Ablate -Kind cpu -Only quest_markers: the compass's processor time; the picture changes (the strip disappears), so quest_markers is a visible switch.
